new_disposal_finding.compatibility: Existing mutable-root/original transaction behavior remains unchanged. An admitted readonly root with no new post-dispose admission may drain; closed/captured roots cannot borrow a later generation.
new_disposal_finding.required_proof: Deterministic barriers: admit root; external dispose starts; attempt/catch write and canonical transaction; root rejects, dispose drains, no persistent effects. No timing sleeps.
